rows.name: multiline-md
rows.tip: Use |md blocks for multi-line markdown labels
rows.source:
box {
  label: |md
  # Title
  **Bold** and *italic*
  - item 1
  - item 2
  |
}

rows.name: record-ports
rows.tip: Use | for fields and :: for field names; escape |{}<> in labels with backslash.

rows.name: html-labels
rows.tip: HTML-like labels use < > tags; wrap the whole label in < > and escape inner < > as < >.

rows.name: clusters
rows.tip: Subgraphs with IDs starting with 'cluster' become boxes; label the cluster with the 'label' attribute.

rows.name: rank-same
rows.tip: Use rank=same in a subgraph to align nodes horizontally; the subgraph must have no edges inside it.

rows.name: edge-ports-compass
rows.tip: Use compass points (n,s,e,w,ne,nw,se,sw) on nodes and port names on edges to control connection points.

rows.name: quoting-identifiers
rows.tip: Identifiers with spaces or special chars must be quoted; quotes inside labels use backslash escaping.

rows.name: escaping_special_chars
rows.tip: Use backslash escaping for quotes and brackets in labels
rows.source: class "He said \"hello\"" { }

rows.name: stereotypes
rows.tip: Wrap stereotypes in guillemets « »
rows.source: class Foo <<service>> { }

rows.name: generics
rows.tip: Use angle brackets for type parameters
rows.source: class List<T> { T get() }

rows.name: visibility_modifiers
rows.tip: Use + - # ~ for public private protected package
rows.source: class A { +pub() -priv() #prot() ~pkg() }

rows.name: abstract_and_interface
rows.tip: Use abstract keyword and <<interface>> stereotype
rows.source: abstract class Base { } class Impl implements <<interface>> Base { }

rows.name: skinparam_styling
rows.tip: Configure appearance with skinparam directives
rows.source:
skinparam class { BackgroundColor lightyellow BorderColor blue }
class Styled { }

rows.name: network_segments
rows.tip: Each network block must declare its own address range; nodes in the same segment share the prefix.

rows.name: multi_network_node
rows.tip: A node can appear in multiple network blocks to represent interfaces on different subnets.
